Gifted (A seasoned actor who proclaims himself as one of the greatest of all time with decades of cinema experience and shows it with his disguises of various heroes, villains and normal citizens that has shown to be able to fool people such as Wonder Woman, Batgirl and Batman briefly. Master manipulator, influencing even the very people that went to recruit him in the first place as seen by his time in the Mud Pack and stated to be a crafty criminal tactician as well)

Extreme cold or heat is good at turning his body's fluidity into solid, allowing him to be temporarily subduedGotham City Sirens #24. Heat up to 1,000 degrees Celsius to his clay core undermines his basic cellular structure. Sufficiently powerful sonics is able to disrupt his metabolismArkham Reborn #3. Water can melt down his body structureDC Comics Presents: Batman. People that he has absorbed is able to be removed through certain poisonous gases. Crowbars are able to trigger PTSD within him, making him blind with rageGotham City Sirens #20. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Deadly Touch: Gained from Preston Payne's blood, Basil is able to surround parts of his body with a special enzyme that's capable of turning whatever organic material it comes in contract with into protoplasm whilst inorganic material will melt away like butter. *Absorption: Gained from Sondra Fuller's blood, Basil is capable of increasing his strength and size by absorbing others into himself, and also capable of gaining unique properties of different minerals or clay via absorbing them them into his body as well. *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Regeneration (Low-High: He can reform himself from puddles of clay, as demonstrated two times as well as surviving having been blasted into a bunch of pieces by fireworks) *Large Size (Type 0 - As shown here) *Nigh-Invulnerability (Any physical blow, no matter how powerful, will only serve to blast his body apart - he can simply reform himself from the fragments left behind and keep fighting) * Shapeshifting (Can change himself into essentially any human-esque form, as demonstrated on innumerable occasions) *Elasticity (His malleable constitution allows him to extend his clay-like flesh in order to attack or restrain enemies, as well as create a huge hole in his torso to avoid attacks, squish his entire body through a sewer grate and become nearly liquid to slip through incredibly small gaps) *Weapon Creation (Can shape his body into various weapons - these include a hammer, extendable claws, lobster claws, an axe, a spiked ball and chain, a brick wall, and a few others) *Paralysis Inducement (Can use parts of his hardened clay body to restrain foes here) *Life Creation (Can create offshoots of his own body, as shown here - he could even create Annie, a sentient being with thoughts and feelings) *Voice Mimicry (Perfectly imitated Bruce Wayne's voice) *Social Influencing (Deception: Is an excellent actor, and has easily convinced people that he is, in fact, the person he has shifted into the form of) *Limited Resistance to Ice Manipulation (By the time of Justice League, he could remain lucid while frozen solid by liquid nitrogen and burst out of the ice that encased him)

Whilst incomplete, destroyed a stone bench with a kick), far higher with hyper-dense bodily weaponry (When he turned his hands into steel mallets, he was able to stagger and harm Martian Manhunter, though this may be inconsistent)

Hypersonic reactions and combat speed (Scaling to Mach 8.7 - Tagged and is a consistent opponent of Batman, and was able to avoid his thrown Batarang at close range. Was capable of tagging Batgirl while she tried to escape his attack. Rushed at and tagged Robin, and morphed his body to shield against Robin's batarang while it was in mid-flight. Hit an extremely off-guard Superman), possibly as high as Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c - Kept up with and tagged Martian Manhunter, and as mentioned above repeatedly tagged Batman - see both profiles for speed scaling), with Superhuman travel speed (Kept ahead of Batman and Robin) - we're never given reason to believe Clayface got any faster between BTAS and TNBA, so this applies to both keys.

Small Building Level, mostly Irrelevant (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Technically, his durability is irrelevant since direct physical attacks would just blast him apart, which he could simply reform from. Cannot maintain his constitution in water or whilst being electrified.

*Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Regeneration (Low-High: He can reform himself from puddles of clay, as demonstrated two times as well as surviving having been blasted into a bunch of pieces by fireworks) *Large Size (Type 0 - As shown here) *Nigh-Invulnerability (Any physical blow, no matter how powerful, will only serve to blast his body apart - he can simply reform himself from the fragments left behind and keep fighting) * Shapeshifting (Can change himself into essentially any human-esque form, as demonstrated on innumerable occasions) *Elasticity (His malleable constitution allows him to extend his clay-like flesh in order to attack or restrain enemies, as well as create a huge hole in his torso to avoid attacks, squish his entire body through a sewer grate and become nearly liquid to slip through incredibly small gaps) *Weapon Creation (Can shape his body into various weapons - these include a hammer, extendable claws, lobster claws, an axe, a spiked ball and chain, a brick wall, and a few others) *Paralysis Inducement (Can use parts of his hardened clay body to restrain foes here) *Life Creation (Can create offshoots of his own body, as shown here - he could even create Annie, a sentient being with thoughts and feelings) *Voice Mimicry (Perfectly imitated Bruce Wayne's voice) *Social Influencing (Deception: Is an excellent actor, and has easily convinced people that he is, in fact, the person he has shifted into the form of) *Limited Resistance to Ice Manipulation (By the time of Justice League, he could remain lucid while frozen solid by liquid nitrogen and burst out of the ice that encased him)
